title: Transcription engine
description: Whether a Virtual Participant separates the voices behind one attendee and, where the ASR MicroVM speech engine is deployed, which engine transcribes each kind of meeting: Amazon Transcribe by default, or the ASR MicroVM engine.
appliesText: A saved change applies to meetings that start at least 30 seconds after the save; a meeting already running keeps its settings.

streamingEngineMicrovm.title: Stream Audio, Chrome extension and Desktop Capture
streamingEngineMicrovm.description: Speaker identification per channel is chosen per meeting, on the Stream Audio form or in the desktop app's settings. While the Amazon Transcribe section uses content redaction, a custom vocabulary or language model, language identification, or a language the deployed speech model does not support, these meetings stay on Amazon Transcribe whichever engine is selected.

virtualParticipantEngineMicrovm.title: Virtual Participants
virtualParticipantEngineMicrovm.description: Speaker names come from the meeting roster with either engine. While the Amazon Transcribe section uses content redaction, a custom vocabulary, language identification, or a language the deployed speech model does not support, Virtual Participants stay on Amazon Transcribe whichever engine is selected.

diarizeVirtualParticipant.title: Virtual Participant voice separation
diarizeVirtualParticipant.description: On by default. Tells apart the voices behind each attendee, so a conference room's people can be shown and named separately, and uses each voice to correct the attendee name where the meeting platform's speaker indicator lags. A name shows as one person unless it reads as a room or its voices are given different names; either can be changed per meeting. Works with either engine: on Amazon Transcribe from its own speaker labels, and on the on-demand engine where its model bundle has speaker identification; with a bundle that has none, the on-demand engine labels by roster name only. Turn it off to name rows from the meeting roster alone.
